result.topic_en: Representations of cubes in the ring of cube roots of unity (ε) give parametrizations and numerical examples of sums and differences of two cubes equal to a multiple of a cube, together with an identity for (B−A)^3+(C−A)^3 derived from cubing α+βε+γεε.

$x+\varepsilon y = (t+\varepsilon u)^3$
$x+\varepsilon\varepsilon y = (t+\varepsilon\varepsilon u)^3$
$x = t^3+u^3-3tuu$
$y = 3tu(t-u)$
$19^3+18^3 = 37.7^3$

$\varepsilon x+\varepsilon\varepsilon y = (t+\varepsilon u)^3$
$\varepsilon\varepsilon x+\varepsilon y = (t+\varepsilon\varepsilon u)^3$
$x = 3ttu-t^3-u^3$
$y^3 = 3tuu-t^3-u^3$
$19^3+1 = 20.7^3$

$(a^3+b^3\varepsilon+c^3\varepsilon\varepsilon)^3 = A+B\varepsilon+C\varepsilon\varepsilon$
$A = a^9+b^9+c^9+6a^3b^3c^3$
$B = 3a^6b^3+3b^6c^3+3c^6a^3$
$C = 3a^6c^3+3b^6a^3+3c^6b^3$
$(B-A)^3+(C-A)^3 = (B+C-2A)(A+B\varepsilon+C\varepsilon\varepsilon)($

Statuamus
$(\alpha+\beta\varepsilon+\gamma\varepsilon\varepsilon)^3 = A+B\varepsilon+C\varepsilon\varepsilon$
$A = \alpha^3+\beta^3+\gamma^3+6\alpha\beta\gamma$
$B = 3\alpha\alpha\beta+3\beta\beta\gamma+3\gamma\gamma\alpha$
$C = 3\alpha\beta\beta+3\beta\gamma\gamma+3\gamma\alpha\alpha$
Erit
$(B-A)^3+(C-A)^3+(2A-B-C)(A+B\varepsilon+C\varepsilon\varepsilon)(A+B\varepsilon\varepsilon+C\varepsilon)=0$
$2A-B-C = 3A-(A+B+C)$

methods.what: Parametrization from x+εy being a cube of t+εu in Z[ε] (ε a primitive cube root of unity)
Numerical examples of sums/differences of two cubes equal to an integer times a cube
Expansion of the cube of a^3+b^3ε+c^3εε into components A,B,C
Identity: (B−A)^3+(C−A)^3 equals (B+C−2A) times the norm-type product of A+Bε+Cεε and its conjugate
